best_pick_sunday_renomination_positive_c.classification_evidence: A control, not a candidate: it closes nothing and is recorded to calibrate what this instrument can see. It demonstrates the harness resolves a 35-point renomination effect on 104 weeks; it was never shown able to resolve a 3-to-5 point one, so it does not license bounded_by_control for any arm in this family.
best_pick_sunday_renomination_positive_c.description: Positive control: perfect-foresight Sunday re-nomination - any still-playable Tuesday-pool game whose graded pick is correct - versus the frozen Tuesday nomination. 104 paired weeks.
best_pick_sunday_renomination_positive_c.notes: LEAD-53 second historical read, docs/best_pick_sunday_renomination.md. Ceiling on the renomination question over this population. Not a bound on the s1/s2/s3 arms: it resolves at 35 points, an order of magnitude above where those arms live. Unit is one Best Pick per week, NOT game-level accuracy points.
best_pick_sunday_renomination_positive_c.plain_summary: If you knew the results in advance and moved the star to a winner every Sunday, you would hit 88% of weeks instead of 53%. This is a yardstick for how much a re-pick could possibly be worth, not a rule anyone can play.
